text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The Constitutional Court has invalidated certain parts of regulation of the social security, creating uncertainty over contribution payment rules.
- A court cleared the former managers of Agrobank from the charge of lending irregularly.
- The number of students from the country who can study at Budapest's ELTE university is limited due to a shortage of student hostel places.
- Only international cooperation can lead to success in the fight against international crime, the participants of a Budapest conference said.
